scope: Unique explicit concrete display IDs in vanilla data/json for eight renderable categories plus runtime IDs from upstream CPP_IDS and required lighting/fallback IDs. Mods, derived vehicle variants, field intensities, overmap rotation/line suffixes, corpses, equipment/mutation overlays, seasonal/variant IDs, effects and runtime generated IDs are not included in this denominator. Static source candidates, including possible obsolete/pseudo definitions; not active runtime total.
game_integration: Core/Overmap Ready and optional Connected standard configs assembled and statically checked; main owner must perform WASM preload, selection and engine runtime test.

virtual_template_anchors.reason: t_dirt inherits this natural-floor template; shared coarse floor fallback
t_wall inherits concrete-wall template; shared concrete-wall fallback
mon_zombie inherits this generic human-zombie template; direct tile anchor for renderer looks_like fallback
field inherits this open-land template; shared overmap fallback
forest inherits this forest template; shared overmap fallback
house_01 and its same-definition house family inherit this house template; shared overmap fallback

imagegen_usage: Original mood studies only; final artwork is explicit native palette-cell source.
completion_limit: Normal static vanilla base candidates have coarse source-backed pictures/UI. Nonvisual/pseudo/development definitions retain unsupported status. Derivatives, individual models/anatomy, seasons, vision variants, equipment overlays and active engine runtime remain separate.
